all.name: Momentum persistence
all.thesis: A metric that moved last cycle moves the same way next cycle.

all.name: Mean reversion
all.thesis: A metric away from its own series mean moves back toward it.

all.name: Acceleration
all.thesis: The second difference, not the first, predicts the next move.

all.name: Consensus fade
all.thesis: When the other personas agree, the crowd is already positioned; fade it.

all.name: Evidence density
all.thesis: Metrics corroborated by more independent sources have more reliable trends.

all.name: Skill-weighted memory
all.thesis: Combine the personas in proportion to the skill they have actually earned.

all.name: Persistence (null model)
all.thesis: Nothing changes.  Every other persona must beat this to be worth keeping.

qualification.rule: A persona is ranked only when it has at least 3 scored forecasts AND the null model does too.  Skill = accuracy − null accuracy, so a persona must beat 'nothing changes' to appear in the ranked table at all.
